name: Check Destiny startup wait
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 50 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format 'status={{.State.Status}} pid={{.State.Pid}} started={{.State.StartedAt}}'
echo entrypoint_wchan:
podman exec upload-assistant-wastaken sh -c 'cat /proc/1/wchan 2>/dev/null || true'
echo data_size:
podman exec upload-assistant-wastaken du -sh /Upload-Assistant/data 2>&1 || true
echo logs:
podman logs --tail 20 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 || true
REMOTE
description: Check whether Destiny’s entrypoint is still blocked on recursive mounted-data permission work.
